requirement: Validate a create-antibiotic command: the name must not be empty or whitespace, the group ID must not be empty, the classification and route must be defined enum members, and the standard dose text must not be empty or whitespace.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access

inputs.text: Amoxicillin, Access, oral route, a valid standard dose, and a version-7 group ID
Meropenem, Watch, intravenous route, a valid standard dose, and a version-7 group ID
Empty name with otherwise valid fields
Whitespace-only name with otherwise valid fields
Guid.Empty as the antibiotic group ID
Route of administration 999 (outside every defined member)
Empty name, empty group, classification 999, route 999, and empty dose

returns.text: Single validation error reported on Name, AntibioticGroupId, Classification, RouteOfAdministration, or StandardDose
Five violations reported for five invalid fields

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
